deskRsRunningTitle: Searching the chain for this wallet's funds

@deskRsRunningTitle.description: Overview and Settings > Recheck balance: title of the panel while the scan a restore needs runs, before it reports a percentage.

deskRsRunningPercent: Searching the chain for this wallet's funds · {percent} %

@deskRsRunningPercent.description: Overview and Settings > Recheck balance: title of the panel while the scan a restore needs runs, with how far it is.

deskRsRunningText: Receiving and sending open when the scan ends. The wallet can stay open meanwhile.

@deskRsRunningText.description: Overview: small text under the restore scan's progress bar.

deskRsRunningFromHeight: From the start height first, then from block 0. Receiving and sending open when both end.

@deskRsRunningFromHeight.description: Overview: small text under the progress bar while a restore that was given a start height scans from it; the scan from block 0 follows by itself.

deskRsWaitingTitle: The restore scan waits for the network

@deskRsWaitingTitle.description: Overview: notice title when a restored wallet's scan cannot run because the app is Offline.

deskRsWaitingText: It starts when Offline is turned off. Until then the balance shows what is on this computer.

@deskRsWaitingText.description: Overview: notice text when a restored wallet's scan waits for Offline to end.

deskRsFailedTitle: The restore scan did not finish

@deskRsFailedTitle.description: Overview: notice title when the scan a restore needs stopped with an error; also the toast title when Try again fails.

deskRsFailedText: Receiving and sending wait for it. It also starts again with the next block.

@deskRsFailedText.description: Overview: notice text when the restore scan stopped with an error.

@deskRsTryAgain.description: Overview: button in the notice when the restore scan stopped; runs it again.

deskRsSendWaits: Sending opens when the restore scan ends.

@deskRsSendWaits.description: Small text under the buttons on Overview while Send is disabled until the restore scan ends.

deskRsRecheckWaits: Recheck balance can start when the restore scan has ended.

@deskRsRecheckWaits.description: Settings > Recheck balance: small text under the disabled Start button while the restore scan runs.

@deskSetRescanFrom.description: Settings > Recheck balance: label of the choice where the scan starts (Advanced > Recheck from a height).

@deskSetRescanFromRecent.description: Settings > Recheck balance: choice that scans from a little before the last scan's end (the default).

deskErrRestoreScanRequired: The restore scan has not finished yet. Receiving and sending open when it ends.

@deskErrRestoreScanRequired.description: Error when the wallet refuses to receive or send because the scan a restore needs has not finished.

@deskSetupSkip.description: First-run Setup: button on every step that leaves Setup without saving; the stored or default node and Epicbox stay.

deskSetupMarkStays: Setup may open again at the next start

@deskSetupMarkStays.description: First-run Setup: toast title when the app could not note that Setup was done or skipped; the reason follows.

deskErrPhraseMismatch: This recovery phrase belongs to another wallet. Nothing was changed.

@deskErrPhraseMismatch.description: Forgot password: error when the typed phrase is valid but not this wallet's.

@deskFpLink.description: Unlock: link under the form that opens Forgot password for the selected wallet.

@deskFpSide.description: Forgot password: the side panel title of the flow.

deskFpWordsLead: Type the recovery phrase of {name}. It sets a new password; the history, notes and labels stay, and nothing is scanned again.

@deskFpWordsLead.description: Forgot password: lead of the phrase step.

@deskFpStepPassword.description: Forgot password: second step's name and title.

deskFpPasswordLead: The phrase is checked against {name} before anything changes.

@deskFpPasswordLead.description: Forgot password: lead of the new-password step.

@deskFpSave.description: Forgot password: primary button on the new-password step.

@deskFpChanging.description: Forgot password: progress title and stage.

@deskFpNotChanged.description: Forgot password: title when it failed.

deskFpDone: New password set. Unlock with it.

@deskFpDone.description: Unlock: green notice after Forgot password set a new password.

@deskFpSameAction.description: Restore > This wallet is already here: button that opens Forgot password with the phrase typed.

deskOnbSameNoteReset: Open asks for that wallet's password. Forgotten it? This phrase sets a new one; the history stays. Cancel keeps the phrase on the grid.

@deskOnbSameNoteReset.description: Restore > This wallet is already here: note under the wallet card.

deskErrResetNoDatabase: This wallet has no history yet. Delete it and restore it from the phrase instead.

@deskErrResetNoDatabase.description: Forgot password: error when the wallet folder holds no database to keep.

@deskOnbRestoreName.description: Restore > password step: label of the optional wallet name field.

@deskOnbRestoreNameHint.description: Restore > password step: hint in the wallet name field.

@deskRsImportOfferTitle.description: Overview: notice title after a wallet was restored from its phrase; offers to import a .wfeh history backup.

deskRsImportOfferText: The restore brings back the funds. Notes, senders, labels and contacts come back from a history backup (.wfeh) of this wallet.

@deskRsImportOfferText.description: Overview: notice text of the import offer after a restore.

@deskRsImportOfferAction.description: Overview: button in the import offer; opens the history backup import.
